summary: Resets state, then walks a linked list (head at this+0xF0) to the node at index this[92] guarded by the list count this+0xFC. For the selected node it requires the node and its data pointer (offset 0x30) to be non-null, runs a bounds/position check, and finally dispatches a virtual call at vtable offset 0x90 (144) on the node data sub-object. Returns 0 on any guard failure.

local_names.v3: current list node pointer during traversal
local_names.v4: node data pointer (first dereference of a node)
local_names.v5: data sub-object whose vtable receives the dispatch

operations.description: StateResetConditionalVirtualCall() runs unconditionally at entry to reset state with conditional virtual dispatch
v2 = this[92] (offset 0x170) reads the target list index
Proceed only when v2 >= 0 and v2 < this[63] (offset 0xFC, the list count/upper bound)
v3 = this[60] (offset 0xF0) reads the linked-list head node pointer
When v2 <= 0, the head node is used directly (LABEL_6); otherwise traversal is required
When v2 > 0, advance v3 = v3[1] (next-pointer field) while v3 is non-null, decrementing v2 until it reaches <= 0, then fall through to node selection
Selected node v3 must be non-null and its data pointer *v3 (v4) must be non-null
BoundsCheckWithPositionQuery(this, *v3) validates the node data against a position/bounds query; a non-zero result is required
v5 = *(_DWORD*)(v4 + 48), the data sub-object at offset 0x30 of the node data, must be non-null for the virtual dispatch
Indirect virtual dispatch: call through v5's vtable at offset 0x90 (entry 144), thiscall with v5
Return the virtual call result, or 0 on any guard failure
